description.en: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve. Use for /in-your-own-words.
description.zh: 用你自己的话，说说你认为用户的目标是什么，用户想解决的是什么问题。用于 /in-your-own-words。

blocks.en: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve.
blocks.zh: 用你自己的话，说说你认为用户的目标是什么，用户想解决的是什么问题。

zh.title: 要它换成自己的话说
zh.does: AI 不照抄你的原话，而是按它的理解重说一遍，理解偏了你一眼就能看出来。
zh.why: 照抄看不出懂没懂，换成自己的话，理解里的偏差才会露出来。
zh.try: 交代任务后先让它复述：「先别动手，用你自己的话说说你打算改什么。」

en.title: Ask for its own words
en.does: The AI doesn't echo your wording; it retells it as it understands it, so a misunderstanding shows at once.
en.why: An echo hides whether it understood; its own words expose any gap.
en.try: After you give a task, ask first: "Before you start, tell me in your own words what you plan to change."

lessons.quote: what you think the user's goals are
lessons.quoteZh: 你认为用户的目标是什么

zh.title: 把理解当成猜测来问
zh.does: 它把自己的理解摆出来等你纠正，而不是当成事实直接开干。
zh.why: 「你认为」三个字把理解变成一个可以被推翻的猜测，AI 说起来不怕错，你改起来也顺手。
zh.try: 问理解时加上「你认为」：「说说你认为我最在意的是速度还是稳定。」

en.title: Ask for its guess
en.does: It lays out its understanding for you to correct, instead of treating it as fact and starting work.
en.why: "What you think" turns understanding into a guess that can be overturned, easy for it to say and for you to fix.
en.try: Frame it as a guess: "Tell me what you think I care about most, speed or stability."

lessons.quote: what problem they're trying to solve
lessons.quoteZh: 用户想解决的是什么问题

zh.title: 把目标和问题分开问
zh.does: 它分别说出你想做成什么、你卡在什么地方，哪一半理解错了一看就知道。
zh.why: 目标是想去哪，问题是卡在哪，分开问，就能看出偏差出在哪一半。
zh.try: 复述时要两样都说：「说说我想做成什么，以及我现在被什么挡住了。」

en.title: Ask for goal and problem separately
en.does: It says what you want to achieve and what's blocking you, so you see which half it got wrong.
en.why: The goal is where you want to go and the problem is what's in the way; asking both shows where the gap is.
en.try: Ask for both: "Tell me what I'm trying to get done, and what's stopping me right now."
